title: Surrounded at -30°: The Battle of Chosin Reservoir (1950)
description:
On 27 November 1950, Chinese forces surrounded about 30,000 UN troops, mostly US Marines and soldiers, at the Chosin Reservoir in North Korea, in temperatures down to -30°F. How many Chinese were there, how many died, how did a bridge fall from the sky, and who really won? We compare the sources.

Sources:
- Wikipedia, "Battle of Chosin Reservoir": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Battle_of_Chosin_Reservoir
- Wikipedia, "Task Force Faith": https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Task_Force_Faith

title: The Bridge That Fell From the Sky #shorts
description:
December 1950: US Marines trapped at the Chosin Reservoir, North Korea, at -30°F, and the Chinese blew up the only bridge on the road to the sea. The fix came by parachute. Would you have tried it? Comment below. Full story on the channel.
